issues.issue: Is there a real risk to him in Port Harcourt or Abuja (the proposed internal flight alternatives)?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says village members have a nationwide network and spiritual powers to track him anywhere in Nigeria.
issues.result_quote: Accordingly, the panel finds that any risk to the claimant is localized and that he has not established a serious possibility of persecution

issues.issue: Would relocating to Port Harcourt or Abuja be unreasonable in all the circumstances?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant argues he lost his home and business, so starting over would be very difficult.
issues.result_quote: Accordingly, the panel finds that it would not be unreasonable for the claimant to relocate to Abuja or Port Harcourt.
